A '''noblewoman''' of the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]] suspected her [[Unidentified Tion noblewoman's husband|husband]] of having an affair and hired a [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] to check his personal [[Holocomm/Legends|holocomm]] records for proof. It was revealed that the husband was not having one affair, but multiple ones, causing the wife to pay the slicer extra to clean out the cheater's financial accounts.<ref>{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Slicing|For Better or Worse}}</ref>
